contract: construct() -> 30 residues r_1, ..., r_30 with 0 <= r_i < p_i for the first 30 primes 2, 3, ..., 113. The score is the largest L such that every integer 1..L is congruent to r_i modulo p_i for some i. Maximize; the optimum is 329 (Jacobsthal's function of the product of the first 30 primes is 330).
notes: For the first 30 primes the optimum is 329, so the task recovers an extremal covering. Exact local certificates are not Lean proofs; the Mahler measure and reciprocal sums are reported as floats. Consult the independent oracle and malformed-input tests.

sources.locator: Thomas Hagedorn, Computation of Jacobsthal's function h(n) for n < 50 (2009). Crossref record inspected; OEIS A048670 inspected: Jacobsthal's function of the product of the first n primes, a(30) = 330 (Hagedorn computed the values for n < 50). By the Chinese remainder theorem a run of L consecutive integers sharing a factor with the primorial is equivalent to covering 1..L with one class per prime, so the maximal covered length is 329. Erdős Problem #687 page inspected (Y(x) << x^2 by Iwaniec; lower bounds of Ford, Green, Konyagin, Maynard and Tao and later improvements).
